endorsements.name: Stephen Röttger
endorsements.label: Popping Calc with Hardware Vulnerabilities
endorsements.description: Over the past few years many hardware vulnerabilities like rowhammer and Spectre were released. But even though they come with cool demos, we haven’t seen them exploited in the wild. Is that because they’re all mitigated or just too slow to exploit in practice? Read more
endorsements.subtitle: OffensiveCon 2020

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
